sources.primary_title: HUMAIN and Applied Intuition Announce Strategic Collaboration to Deploy Physical AI Across Saudi Arabia, Starting with Autonomous Trucking
sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, HUMAIN and Applied Intuition announced a strategic collaboration to establish a national-scale framework for physical AI in Saudi Arabia, beginning with the world's largest autonomous trucking network. The partnership aims to deploy thousands of autonomous trucks across key Saudi logistics corridors by 2030. The initiative leverages HUMAIN's sovereign AI infrastructure and Applied Intuition's end-to-end physical AI platform, including its Self-Driving System (SDS) and Vehicle OS. The deployment will start with autonomous trucking to address workforce constraints, improve road safety, and increase freight capacity, before expanding into robotaxis, ports, mining, and agriculture. Applied Intuition has also established a Riyadh office to build a local team and support the long-term goal of making the Kingdom a global center for autonomous logistics.
